query:
SELECT
  message,
  ordinal,
  shape,
  body
FROM
  segments
WHERE
  (message, ordinal) IN (
    SELECT
      message,
      ordinal
    FROM
      span_edges
    UNION
    SELECT
      message,
      ordinal
    FROM
      senses
    UNION
    SELECT
      source_message,
      source_ordinal
    FROM
      segment_links
    UNION
    SELECT
      target_message,
      target_ordinal
    FROM
      segment_links
    UNION
    SELECT
      message,
      ordinal
    FROM
      conversational
    UNION
    SELECT
      message,
      ordinal
    FROM
      flailed
  )
ORDER BY
  message,
  ordinal
